props.name: imageUrl
props._description: Picks the avatar picture from the resource library. Takes precedence over `icon` and `text` when set.

props.name: icon
props._description: Icon shown instead of a picture. Used when `imageUrl` is empty.

props.name: text
props._description: Initials or short text shown when neither `imageUrl` nor `icon` is set.

props.name: view
props._description: `filled` gives the avatar a solid background; `outlined` gives it a border and transparent centre.

props.name: theme
props._description: Colour role: `normal` for neutral surface colours, `brand` for the brand accent.

props.name: enableHeaderText

content.name: Header Text
content._description: The caption text shown beside the control.

position.name: Header Position
position._description: Which side of the control the caption sits on: `left`, `top`, `right` or `bottom`.

props._description: Turns on a caption attached to the control. When true, the `_true` sub-props supply the caption text and which side it sits on.

props.name: enableFooterText

position.name: Header Position
position._description: Which side the footer caption sits on: `left`, `top`, `right` or `bottom`.

props._description: Turns on a second caption below/after the control, configured the same way as `enableHeaderText`.
